newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Baiyin Building 96 net rises, turnover falls.
newsitem.headline: China Baiyin Building 96 net rises, turnover falls.

text.p: China's Baiyin Copper Commercial Building (Group) Co Ltd said on Wednesday its 1996 net profit was 8.56 million yuan, up 37.8 percent from the 1995 level, while turnover dipped 1.9 percent.

Baiyin, based in the remote northwestern province of Gansu, reduced costs by cutting sales commissions and through property subcontracting, the company's annual report published in Wednesday's Shenzhen-based Securities Times said.
The property company, which also has entertainment and retail business interests, posted turnover of 101.4 million yuan in 1996 compared with 103.3 million yuan in 1995, it said.
In 1996, Baiyin's net earnings per share were 0.17 yuan, up 37.1 percent from 0.124 yuan in 1995, it said.
The company was planning a three-for-10 bonus issue for its 50 million outstanding shares and the plan would be presented at a company shareholder's meeting on April 28, it said.
Trading of Baiyin's A shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange was suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon.
